tenderSchedule.title: PROVIDING MANPOWER FOR VIJAYAPURA AIRPORT Call -3
tenderSchedule.description: Select an Agency for providing manpower for Vijayapura Airport at Madhabhavi Village, Vijayapura District for KSIIDC
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation

tenderAddress.blockNumber: KSIIDC No 49 Khanija Bhavan 4th Floor East wing Racecourse Road

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Any document uploading shall be made in the corresponding parts only as specified in the RFP document

All required original documents shall be scanned and uploaded in e-procurement. Failure to upload any document in e-proc will be considered as non responsive. The Bidders shall submit all the original documents uploaded as per RFP conditions.
No Interest will be paid for EMD (Bid Security)
KSIIDC reserves the right to accept or reject any of the tenders without assigning any reasons thereof.
Submission of Forms 3A, 3B, 3C, 3E, 3F, 3G, 3H, 3I, as per Technical Proposal
Supporting documents for legal entity as per RFP
Supporting documents to prove the years of experience with eligible assignments as per RFP
Supporting documents to prove the financial capacity of the applicant as per RFP

Any entity which has been barred/ blacklisted by the Central Government, any State Government, a statutory authority, or a public sector undertaking, Banks/Financial Institutions as the case may be, from participating in any service, and the bar subsists as on the date of the Proposal, would not be eligible to submit a Proposal either by itself or through its Associate. (Applicant shall submit undertaking on companys letter head with notarized affidavit and upload it in the e-procurement portal)
Applicant shall submit Self-attested copy of a valid License from Police Department to engage in business of providing Manpower services

An Applicant or its Associate should have, during the last 3 (three) years, neither failed to perform on any agreement, as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Applicant or its Associate, nor been expelled from any service or agreement nor have had any agreement terminated for breach by such Applicant or its Associate. (Applicant shall submit undertaking on companys letter head with notarized affidavit and upload it in the e-procurement portal)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Applicant should have minimum 5 years experience in providing or supply of Manpower to Private or Government entities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certification of Incorporation, Technical Proposal Submission Form at Section 3A, Details of the Bidder at Section 3I

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have experience in undertaking at least one (01) assignment on deployment of manpower services having a minimum contract value of Rs. 1 (one) Crore each (Rupees One Crore only) for a Central Government / State Government entities / Public Sector clients. The contract / work order and completion certificate for the eligible assignment should have been issued for providing manpower within the last five (5) years (as on PDD). Eligible Service / Contract Type Experience of working with Government/Semi-Government/ Private entities, including Union Territories/ State Governments / Government of India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Format at Section 3B , The following documents - Work Order/ Contract / Agreement, Completion Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Not Blacklisted / Barred and Not Involved in Major Litigation Affecting Service Delivery: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted / barred by any Central or State Government or PSU and should not be involved in any major litigation that may affect or compromise the delivery of service required. Further, in the last 5 (five) years, the Bidder or any of their Associates has neither failed to perform on any contract, as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Bidder, nor been expelled from any project or contract by any public authority nor have had any contract terminated by any public authority for breach on our part.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Technical Proposal Submission Form at Section 3A

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average Annual Turnover: The Bidder should have had an average annual turnover of at least INR 2.5 Crores (Rupees Two Crores Fifty Lakh only) for any of 3 (three) financial years out of last 5 (Five) financial years (i.e., FY 2020- 21, FY 2021-22, FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26)
